attr.title: GoldenEye 007
attr.desc: Alpha native AArch64/GLES GoldenEye 007 source port for R36S with the ARM-GE Glass Control Deck. Supply your own verified US NTSC ROM; first launch generates ROM-derived sidecars locally.
attr.inst: PortMaster install: install ge007.zip normally. Direct EmulationStation install: extract the ZIP into the active ROM volume's ports directory so 'GoldenEye 007.sh' sits beside the ge007/ folder, then refresh/restart EmulationStation. Put your own US NTSC ROM at ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64. PortMaster support files must already be installed; the PortMaster UI does not need to be opened to launch the game.
